clips.text: It went from above $81 ,000 after the election to below $75 ,000 by the weekend. U .S. Bitcoin ETFs had about $1 .3 billion in net outflows just last week. And Bitcoin really hasn't participated in the Monday rally.

clips.text: Of course, Bitcoin dropped pretty massively over the weekend alongside the tech sell -off that we saw, the Democrat blue wave, the Binance hack. But I don't check it on an hourly basis. It seemed to have bounced very nicely at a very key level around $74 ,000, around the 50 -weekly MA, which we've talked about many times.
